name: Assisted Pull-Up
steps: Select the counterweight on an assisted pull-up machine, take a wider-than-shoulder overhand grip, and kneel smoothly on the assistance pad.
Begin from straight arms with your shoulder blades drawn slightly down and your abs braced.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your sides until your chin clears handle height.
Lower yourself with control until your arms return to full extension without bouncing the pad.
tips: Avoid tipping your head back to clear the handles.
Step off the assistance pad slowly so the counterweight returns safely.
